title: CORRECT: setauthsize called in set_tag not in decrypt — it is a transform property
description: crypto_aead_setauthsize configures the transform, not the request. Calling it in set_tag sets it exactly once when the caller establishes the tag length, before any crypt operation. Calling it in decrypt instead would add per-call overhead and place a transform-configuration call inside a data-path function, violating the kernel AEAD API's init/config/use sequencing. A reviewer might suggest moving it into decrypt to 'keep set_tag simple', but that conflates transform state with per-operation parameters.
